protocol_changelog.note: Initial build. Manifest train_episodes=200 had NO source (no code reads it; no document justifies it); default.yaml used 500 (Paper 2 Table I).

train_episodes := 500 (Paper 2 Table I: 'Training episodes / checkpoint interval 500 / 25'; also configs/default.yaml and docs/EXPERIMENT_PROTOCOL.md). Manifest now mirrors eval_every, n_train_seeds, checkpoint_every, episode_steps and pins config_hash. Federated lifecycle, statistics accounting and relevance attribution as repaired on audit/federated-lifecycle-fixes (federated.maturity_eps=0.05, max_buffer_age_s=600). Smoke config is not part of the protocol.

PREPARATION release (nothing has been run at publication scale). (1) n_train_seeds 5 -> 10 (training seeds 0..9): with 5 seeds the exact Wilcoxon test cannot reach p<0.05 and Holm over 10 comparisons needs >=9 seeds; 10 seeds make a Holm-corrected Wilcoxon *attainable* (min p = 2^-9 = 0.00195 < 0.05/10) but guarantee nothing about significance, power or effect size. (2) federated.retry: bounded deterministic exponential back-off after REJECTED/EXPIRED updates (base 120 s = agg_timeout_s, factor 2, cap 480 s), counters retries / deferred / rejected+expired bytes; reset by commit or by a newer global install. (3) FederatedClient.install_global: blend==1 is now an exact replacement (1*theta+0*cur turned a non-finite local actor into NaN). Methodology of the semantic aggregation, the relevance definition, maturity_eps (0.05), the statistics settlement rule and all learners are UNCHANGED; open author decisions are listed in docs/AUTHOR_DECISIONS.md and none was silently resolved. Protocol 2.0 is preserved verbatim in configs/protocols/v2.0/ (config_hash 7f4a0e4f66569528) and git tag protocol-2.0.

architecture.note: Exactly one USV. Any 2-USV Paper-2 scaling point is adapted to 1 USV.
